# Kora Demo

> Kora Demo is located at 48 Strawberry Hill Ave in Stamford, CT, offering a wide range of classic Thai dishes prepared with fine ingredients and premium spices. The menu features traditional options including curries, noodle dishes like Pad Thai, stir-fries, rice plates, soups, and appetizers.

## Menu
Offers a wide range of classic Thai dishes including various curries, noodle dishes like Pad Thai, stir-fries, rice plates, soups, and appetizers.
